name: thinking-block-reasoning-attr-off

nondeterminism.reason: The toggle-off render of the live Reasoning delta collapses the thinking frame to its border row, and one border cell alternates between `─` and `_` across renders (style diff at the same cell: -@▁ vs -@─, text diff one column of frame width, measured in the 2026-10-08 full-corpus prove). The frame edge follows a clock-derived streaming indicator on the live-delta path, so its phase differs per render. thinking-block-reasoning-attr (toggle-on, same surface) is fully deterministic and keeps its golden; only the collapsed-frame render is withheld.
nondeterminism.varying_region: Row 2, col 114 — the last border cell of the collapsed thinking frame, in both dumps.
nondeterminism.surface_of_fix: Freeze the streaming-indicator phase under App::is_simulating (derive from the simulated frame index, not a real clock), the same freeze pattern the corpus asks of debug-overlay and footer-bar. Production change made for a test, so the golden is withheld; the show_reasoning == false assertion still guards the toggle-off state machine.

notes: Split out of thinking-block-reasoning-attr, whose 120x40 variant this is. That scenario's notes explain the two-render-input design: a regression collapsing Reasoning into Thinking or ignoring the /reasoning toggle is caught by the parent's golden plus this assertion.
